testSources.description: Container-ended math regressions and expanded EOF, fence, whitespace, line-ending, and container-prefix cases; expected values checked against the pinned remark-parse/remark-math runtime.
Task callback slice-one-character behavior and list-ended fenced code values from the pinned remark-parse/remark-gfm runtime; LF, CRLF, CR, and byte-feed coverage.
Pinned micromark GFM table escape and empty-row semantics, actual body-cell counts and source positions; whole/byte feeds, CR/LF/CRLF, containers, and sparse-row allocation regression.

585 raw math EOF/container inputs from the pinned default remark parser, including the original 369 inputs and 216 real-EOL quote/fence/container controls. Whole and byte feeds compare exact values and both source endpoints for every actual math node. Original 5639 math-boundary frames additionally compare count and value.

1431 actual raw Web inputs: 608 definition inputs, 585 complete math ancestor-wrapper controls, 81 merged/container controls, original latex-915 long corpus, three reported spread regressions, all 46 definition-list-multi scalar prefixes across LF/CRLF/CR and 15 marker/lazy controls. Checks selected structure, list/item/description spread, byte endpoints and term text origins with whole and byte feeds. All selected endpoints are now strict, including the previously unsupported virtual-tab term text and 18 footnote-prefix blank-EOF endpoints; their actual Web coordinates are unchanged.

288 actual raw Web inputs: paragraph-to-table conversion in root, quote, list and footnote containers, LF/CRLF/CR, code/math/emphasis/Unicode prefixes and header link/code nodes. Selected complete node structure, literal values and all source endpoints are checked with whole and byte feeds.
277 pinned Web autolink inputs: punctuation-start literal emails and matched Link/Text subject spans, physical table/container rows, both Web-position modes and underscore attention isolation.

365 actual raw Web and default HAST inputs: 34 original math-boundary prefixes, 324 HTML tag/comment/attribute whitespace, physical EOL and container controls, and seven ordinary/protected syntax cases. Whole/byte feeds, tracking parity, exact UTF-8 literals, unchanged custom source ranges and unchanged legacy literals/ranges are checked in 36502 assertions.

252 actual raw Web tilde inputs covering unmatched one/two markers, long runs, matched single/double delete, mismatched delimiters, UTF-8 prefixes, physical CR/LF/CRLF, containers and multiline spans. Selected literal and delete positions use actual token events; metadata-on/off native ranges and traversal remain identical.

1630 actual raw Web inputs: 963 existing spread footnote cases, the 22 prior shape failures (deduplicated), 120 container/EOL controls and all 302 definition-stress inputs and 72 blank/indented description-spread controls, the 126 definition-list inputs, original latex-915 long corpus and 27 thematic-break/EOL/container controls. Whole and byte feeds check selected list/item/quote/footnote/definition/code/paragraph structure, container/code/ordinary-paragraph/thematic-break source endpoints, code metadata values and list/item/definition-description spread; tracking preserves every native range. Task callback paragraph positions remain owned by their separate callback evidence. Existing table-prefix paragraph events are preserved. The original 5791-input legacy table-profile census additionally has zero shape, spread-value or missing-spread differences.

54 actual raw Web inputs distinguish physical trailing-space/backslash hard breaks from detached soft line endings in definition resolution, with root/quote, LF/CRLF/CR and partial-tab term text. Whole and byte feeds compare exact inline values and both endpoints; detached soft-break events retain their original physical EOL kind.

changes.change: feat(footnotes): preserve definitions and labels in an opt-in lossless AST
feat(highlight): parse double-equals delimiters with Web-compatible boundaries
feat(autolinks): recognize Web-compatible literal URLs and email addresses
feat(emphasis): add opt-in flanking rules for adjacent extension delimiters
fix(emphasis): align Unicode flanking and delimiter spans with Web behavior
feat(definition-lists): parse terms and descriptions with spread metadata
feat(renderers): support definition lists across output formats
feat(math): parse opt-in inline and fenced math nodes
feat(references): preserve link definitions as source-positioned AST leaves
fix(decoding): share single-pass string decoding for math and references
feat(references): expose usage identity and Web-compatible identifiers
feat(decoding): add opt-in Web character-reference semantics
feat(code): expose source-based code metadata without changing literals
feat(code): support long delimiters with opt-in Web syntax
fix(code): normalize escaped pipes in table code metadata
feat(softbreaks): expose physical line endings from parser events

implementationReferences.description: Web escape-state rules used to implement an opt-in C scanner; actual table row structure and positions checked against the pinned Web pipeline.
Definition container linePrefix sizes, opaque exit boundaries and physical term flow chunks, integrated with the existing opt-in list-spread event ledger.

htmlText linePrefix excludes at most three virtual columns after a physical line ending. The opt-in definition-list profile compiles the actual matched subject interval through recorded physical EOL and visual-column events; source endpoints remain independent of compiled literal length.
